vocabulary.note_en: cost too much = be too expensive

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fixed time to see someone
vocabulary.example: I made an appointment with the doctor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the part that gives power to a phone

vocabulary.example: I go to the dentist twice a year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a dentist cleans your teeth
vocabulary.example: I have a teeth cleaning on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: easily hurt by cold or heat
vocabulary.example: My teeth are sensitive to cold water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tooth that is bad and damaged
vocabulary.example: The dentist found a decayed tooth.
The dentist will take out the tooth.

vocabulary.meaning_en: put material into a hole in a tooth
vocabulary.example: The dentist will fill the cavity.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food that is easy to eat, like soup
vocabulary.example: Eat soft food after the dentist.

vocabulary.meaning_en: short trips to do small jobs, like the bank or shop
vocabulary.example: I have some errands to run today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: should get something because of what you did
vocabulary.example: You worked hard. You deserve a rest.

fine_lines.title: expensive vs costs too much
fine_lines.explanation_ar: expensive صفة (The phone is expensive)، و cost فعل (It costs too much). المعنى متقارب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Expensive" is an adjective. "Cost" is a verb: it costs too much.

examples.sentence: I want a new phone, but it costs too much.

fine_lines.title: painful vs sensitive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: painful تعني مؤلم (يسبب ألمًا)، و sensitive تعني حسّاس (يتأثر بسهولة بالبرد أو الحر).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Painful = it hurts. Sensitive = easily hurt by cold or heat.

expressions.phrase: How are you doing this week?
expressions.example: Hi Sara! How are you doing this week?
My phone is slow. Oh no, that is annoying.

expressions.meaning_en: Say the price is too high.
expressions.example: I like that bag, but it costs too much.
I made an appointment with the dentist.
A new battery helps. That is good to know.
I have two exams tomorrow. That sounds hard.

expressions.phrase: You should rest and eat soft food.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن ترتاح وتأكل طعامًا ليّنًا.
expressions.example: You should rest and eat soft food for a few days.
We worked hard. We deserve a relaxing weekend.

grammar.title: Past simple: what happened
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن أحداث انتهت: I made an appointment. I went to the dentist yesterday. My brother got a new battery last month. (make → made، go → went، get → got، tell → told)
grammar.explanation_en: Past simple for finished actions: made, went, got, told.
examples: I made an appointment to get a new battery.
I went to see the dentist yesterday.
The dentist told me that I have a decayed tooth.

grammar.title: Future with will
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will للخطط والمستقبل: I will go to the dentist next Wednesday. He will take it out.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will + base verb for the future.
examples: I will go to the dentist again next Wednesday.
The dentist will fill them later.

grammar.title: should for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: should + الفعل في أصله للنصيحة: You should rest.
examples: You should eat soft food for a few days.
You should get a new battery.

questions.question: A hole in a tooth is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: cavity تجويف أو تسوّس في السن.
questions.explanation_en: A cavity is a hole in a tooth.
